Al Nawmasi: heartfelt prayers for the nation’s leader and builder of its renaissance
Published: 20-03-2022 | Author: Al Riyadh newspaper
https://www.alriyadh.com/1940872
Sheikh Abdullah bin Muteb Al Nawmasi, Qassim Chamber board member and chairman of Alabaqra Trading & Contracting, congratulated Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, described in the historical article as Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defense, on the King's discharge from King Faisal Specialist Hospital following successful medical examinations.
He expressed the happiness felt by the Saudi people and noted the response on social media as evidence of their bond with their leader. He offered sincere prayers that God protect the nation's leader and builder of its modern renaissance, and grant him lasting health and a long life.

Al Nawmasi: budget figures confirm the success of economic diversification
Published: 18-12-2021 | Author: Ahmed
Abdullah bin Muteb Al Nawmasi, Qassim Chamber board member, congratulated King Salman bin Abdulaziz and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman on the announcement of the 2022 state budget, saying its positive indicators reinforced the Kingdom's regional and global standing.
He said the budget's promise of growth and development reflected the strength and resilience of the Saudi economy in overcoming economic challenges, and the leadership's commitment to citizens' welfare and the country's prosperity. The projected surplus of around SAR 90 billion (approximately USD 24 billion) supported economic optimism and cash reserves, indicated greater expansion in economic and social projects, human development and health, and strengthened the appeal of domestic and foreign investment. He said it demonstrated the success of economic diversification in raising non-oil revenue to unprecedented levels. He concluded with prayers for the country's security, stability and prosperity under the King and Crown Prince.

Alabaqra wins Qassim University cleaning contract, 2021
Published: 10-11-2021
Alabaqra Trading & Contracting Co. Ltd. won the cleaning contract for Qassim University's main campus at Al Mulaida (rendered “Al Mida” in the original article). The contract was signed by University President Dr. Abdulrahman Al Dawood and Alabaqra Chairman Abdullah bin Muteb Al Nawmasi.

Alabaqra Trading & Contracting: a third of a century of creativity and giving
Published: 10-11-2021
At Al Mithnab Sukkari Festival, Prince Dr. Faisal bin Mishal bin Saud bin Abdulaziz, Governor of Qassim, honored the festival's official sponsor, Abdullah bin Muteb Al Nawmasi, chairman of Alabaqra and Qassim Chamber board member, in the presence of the Governor of Al Mithnab.

Qassim Governor honors the Beekeepers Forum’s official sponsor
Published: 10-11-2021
Under the patronage of Prince Dr. Faisal bin Mishal bin Saud bin Abdulaziz, Governor of Qassim, the Governorate's Undersecretary Dr. Abdulrahman bin Hussein Al Wazzan honored Qassim Chamber board member and Alabaqra Chairman Abdullah bin Muteb Al Nawmasi at the first Qassim Beekeepers Forum, held at Qassim International Convention and Exhibition Center in Buraydah. The article describes the recognition as meaningful to the sponsor.

Commerce Minister appoints Abdullah Al Nawmasi to the Qassim Chamber board
Published: 09-11-2021
The Minister of Commerce, Dr. Majid bin Abdullah Al Qasabi, appointed Abdulaziz bin Abdullah Al Humaid, Sulaiman bin Abdullah Al Muhanna Aba Al Khail, Abdullah bin Muteb Al Nawmasi and Siham bint Saleh Al Qafari to the Qassim Chamber of Commerce and Industry board for its twelfth four-year term, 1442–1446 AH. These appointments completed the twelve-member board. For the first time in the Chamber's history, a woman joined its board. Al Qafari thanked the minister for the confidence placed in her and her colleagues to contribute to the country's progress and prosperity.

Al Nawmasi: a homeland guided by unmatched wisdom and experience
Published: 09-11-2021
Abdullah bin Muteb Al Nawmasi, Qassim Chamber board member and chairman of Alabaqra Trading & Contracting, said the accession anniversary came as the country stood resolute under the care of its leaders. He reflected on the Kingdom's evolving policies and its rapid response to domestic and international events. He congratulated the leadership on the seventh anniversary of King Salman's accession and shared citizens' prayers for the country's success and protection.
He argued that a country's influence and effectiveness are no longer measured solely by population, economic strength or other traditional factors. Domestic and foreign decision-making, the ability to achieve goals and the harmony between citizens and the state had become defining features of Saudi policy during King Salman's seven years in office.
He described good governance as a method that strengthens a country's position locally and internationally. Experienced and capable administrators can create opportunities and use the space available in political, economic and social affairs. He identified its dimensions as applying Sharia, achieving justice and equality, affirming sovereignty, demonstrating effectiveness and influence, and delivering comprehensive development.

pages.title: About us
pages.text:
About us
Alabaqra Trading & Contracting Co. Ltd. was established to provide maintenance management, contracting, operations and related services to the public and private sectors throughout Saudi Arabia. Over the years, the company describes having built an excellent reputation and a leading position in specialized maintenance and operations services, with reliable capabilities for delivering projects in the Kingdom. It takes pride in its relationship with continuing public and private sector growth and looks forward to providing more advanced services in the years ahead.

pages.text:
Our goal
Alabaqra has set itself an ambitious goal, one shared by companies seeking to deliver services that justify their clients' expenditure through determination and customer confidence. Our goal is to become one of Saudi Arabia's largest service providers in contracting, city cleaning, waste disposal, electrical maintenance and operations, and water and wastewater operations.

pages.title: The Arab statesman’s achievements at the G20 summit
pages.text:
The Arab statesman’s achievements at the G20 summit
Published: 26-11-2020 | Author: Alabaqra — Ayman Taha
Businessman Abdullah Muteb Al Nawmasi, Qassim Chamber board member and chairman of Alabaqra Trading & Contracting, said Saudi Arabia's success at the Riyadh 2020 summit was evident in the leaders' commitment to keeping markets open and pursuing a free, fair, transparent and predictable investment environment. He said these outcomes demonstrated the Kingdom's fulfillment of its G20 presidency commitments through its leadership and people, enabling humanity to seize opportunities in the twenty-first century.
He added that the success of the Saudi G20 presidency culminated in the leaders' summit chaired by King Salman, praising economic, health and precautionary measures to reduce the pandemic's impact and support the most vulnerable.
He also praised the Crown Prince's oversight of the year's agenda, initiatives, in-person and virtual meetings, and coordination among member countries in responding to COVID-19, culminating in the successful Riyadh summit and its final communiqué.
